how: We read the website of every Kansas City wedding planner listed on Lazo (88 listings, 75 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: honeymoon travel agents, officiants, DJ and production companies, venues that bundle a coordinator, and a national chain's landing pages. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Full planning, partial or day-of only? Ask what each tier includes in meetings, hours on the day and vendor management.
Which Kansas City venues have you run a wedding at this year, and do you know their rain plans and load-in rules?
Who is on site on the day, the planner I hired or an associate, and how many weddings does your team take on the same weekend?

picks.name: Hitched Planning + Design
picks.blurb: Making spreadsheets feel romantic since 2009, in its own words, Hitched has helped hundreds of couples from the first inspiration board to the send-off. A Lenexa team of planners, designers and logistics people with a streamlined process laid out on the site.

picks.name: Trinity Events KC
picks.blurb: Trinity Events is a luxury wedding planner and designer in Kansas City offering bespoke designs through a tailored experience. The site offers multiple packages so you buy the amount of support needed to sleep at night, and introduces the founder with a Diet Coke in hand.

picks.name: Simple Elegance
picks.blurb: Simple Elegance calls itself the secret ingredient to hundreds of weddings over the years, a full-service Kansas City planning and coordination firm based in Olathe. The site spells out what full-service planning covers, from guidance and creative input to logistics.

picks.name: Weddings by Hannah
picks.blurb: Hannah Schumm specializes in full-service planning, custom design and execution, with a focus on polished designs and guest experience; she describes her style as approachable upscale elegance with an edge. Kansas City based, with the all-inclusive package explained on the site.

picks.name: At Ease Events KC
picks.blurb: At Ease Events says it is not there to plan your wedding for you but to help you create one that feels like you, not a Pinterest board. Planning, coordination and design for bold, intentional weddings, micro weddings and elopements in Kansas City.

picks.name: TRUElove Coordinating and Design
picks.blurb: Keasha runs TRUElove Coordinating and Design as an authentic and bold full-service planning and design company in Kansas City. The full package starts with monthly meetings from the minute you book, for couples who want help every step of the way.

picks.name: Wild Hill Flowers and Events
picks.blurb: Wild Hill Flowers and Events pairs wedding planning with custom floral design, so one team handles both. The founder graduated from K-State in 2006, and the Spring Hill firm says its process starts by identifying the elements that fit your style.

picks.name: Belcher Event Services Team, LLC
picks.blurb: Kristin Belcher of BEST-KC joined a local Kansas City venue in 2021 and grew from venue management into full-service wedding planning and floral design. Based in Liberty, she offers both planning and custom wedding flowers.

picks.name: Studio Floral and Events
picks.blurb: Studio Floral and Events does full-service wedding and event planning alongside flowers, furniture rentals, lighting, pipe and drape, and custom fabrication and installations. A Kansas City studio for couples who want design and logistics from one source.

picks.name: Aventi Weddings - Photography, Videography, and Coordination
picks.blurb: Aventi Weddings puts coordinators on the same in-house team as its photographers and videographers, so the day is planned and captured by people who work together. Serving Kansas City and worldwide.
